name: free-claude-code
description: Use Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, VSCode, Pi, and OpenCode (and 6 other harnesses) for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone, and now from the browser with native browser sessions (multi-harness + multi-model) like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
one_liner: A tool that lets you use Claude Code and other AI coding assistants by routing requests through free or discounted AI model providers instead of paying full price.
buyer: An individual developer or small team trying to minimize AI coding tool costs — not really a business-to-business opportunity since it's about avoiding paying for official tools.
business_use_cases: A solo indie developer uses it to get Claude-Code-like functionality without a paid subscription, by routing to free-tier providers.
A cash-strapped startup lets its small eng team use multiple AI harnesses cheaply instead of paying for several per-seat licenses.
A content creator makes a paid tutorial or course for developers wanting to cut their AI tooling costs.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid setup/support service or community helping non-technical developers configure and maintain this cost-optimization tool

steal_this: Honestly, the only real money here is a one-off paid tutorial teaching people how to set this up — it's a cost-avoidance tool, not a product, and it also sits in a legal/ToS gray zone with the providers it routes around.
